from collections import deque, Counter
import json
def cc(G,c):
    H,W=len(G),len(G[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    q=deque(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if G[i][j]==c and not seen[i][j]:
                seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while True:
                    if not q: break
                    r,k=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,k))
                    for dr,dj in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        nr,nk=r+dr,k+dj
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nk<W and not seen[nr][nk] and G[nr][nk]==c:
                            seen[nr][nk]=True;q.append((nr,nk))
                comps.append(cells)
    return comps
